rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=7, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, outer_wall_s=1700, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-15: ONE confirmation knob -> seed 123 -> 7, at the iter-13/14 val_n=24 PEAK basis (val_n=24/ep12/lr1e-4/warm_start=True/n_iter600/grad_clip1.0/unet_c16). This is a 3rd-seed averaged CEILING-FINALIZATION read on the WIDER 24-scene basis -- a CONFIRMATION move, NOT a ceiling-raiser (no ceiling-raiser remains for the over-parameterized U-Net on this 128-view synthetic substrate). DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): the two val_n=24 seed reads landed seed42=0.4616 (iter-13, PSNR 13.45, hr 0.0011) and seed123=0.4431 (iter-14, PSNR 14.06, hr 0) -> |delta|=0.0185 -- TIGHTER than the val_n=12 seed42-vs-seed123 delta of 0.024 (iter-10 0.4724 vs iter-11 0.4484), confirming the iter-14 hypothesis that doubling 12->24 scenes shrinks the per-scan init stochasticity via the ~sqrt(2) averaging argument. BUT a 2-sample mean (0.4524) has an unconstrained standard error -- 'is ~0.45 the converged wider-basis ceiling?' is not finalizable from only two draws. This exactly mirrors the val_n=12 history, where a 3rd seed (seed=7, iter-12, 0.4305) was needed to turn the 2-sample pair into a 3-seed mean+/-std (0.4504, std 0.0173). FAILURE MODE = the 0.466 M-param U-Net OVERFITS each single noisy 128-view sparse-phantom scan (the 6-param bilateral twin physically cannot, which is why the twin clears baseline at hr+0.33 while this U-Net stays hr~0 at ~0.45-0.51 SSIM); the per-image fit has an init-driven stochastic noise floor that a wider val basis shrinks but does not eliminate. EXHAUSTED / FORBIDDEN axes (do NOT retry, per handoff): n_iter (iter-2 1200 steps 0.4785->0.4293, per-scan overfit), warm_start (iter-8 off -0.0595, load-bearing-positive), lr (iter-3 1e-3->1e-4 + iter-9 1e-4->2e-4 bracket 1e-4 as the per-scan optimum), pretrain_epochs (ep12 peak, ep18 worse 0.5016), unet_c (design-doc warned-against; mayo n2i c16->c32 flat 0.9508), grad_clip=1.0 (LOAD-BEARING 128/2304-view FBP-adjoint overflow guard, mandatory). The ONLY genuinely-untried confirmation knob is a 3RD seed AT the val_n=24 basis. LEVER CHOICE: seed 123 -> 7 at the val_n=24 PEAK config -- the SAME 3rd seed (7) used at val_n=12, so the val_n=24 3-seed mean is directly comparable to the val_n=12 3-seed mean (0.4504, std 0.0173), letting us read off how much the wider basis tightened the std. HYPOTHESIS: seed=7 at val_n=24 lands inside the [0.43, 0.47] band, yielding a 3-seed val_n=24 mean ~0.45 with a TIGHTER std than the val_n=12 0.0173 (the sqrt(2) averaging finally pinned down) -- a trustworthy, FINALIZED wider-basis ceiling for the per-image U-Net N2I on this synthetic 128-view substrate. hr stays ~0 (structurally FBP-bounded on dense 128-view phantoms). FALSIFIER: if seed=7 lands FAR outside [0.43, 0.47] (e.g. <0.41 or >0.49), the wider-basis std is NOT tighter than val_n=12 and the per-scan noise floor is INTRINSIC to the N2I objective (not just init-set sampling that wider averaging cancels) -- that wide intrinsic floor IS the documented ceiling finding, confirming the over-parameterized U-Net is the wrong tool here vs the bilateral twin (hr+0.33). Either branch FINALIZES the ceiling documentation toward the iter-20 mandate. WALL: warm 12x200=2400 + per-image 24x600=14400 = 16800 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 1394 s; iter-13 ran this exact budget in 1651 s and iter-14 in 1533 s, under the outer_wall_s=1700 guard (per_scene_s = 1700/24 ~= 71 s, ample for 600 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 50 s) and under the 00:30:00 (1800 s) sbatch wall. All recon-affecting knobs IDENTICAL to the iter-13/14 val_n=24 config (train_n=200, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, lr=1e-4, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1700); ONLY seed 123 -> 7 changed.
